arguments.prompt: Design ONE desktop screen for Cesta: Compra / Comparar. Original professional Spanish household suite, editorial accounts ledger, not generic SaaS. Fixed dark forest248px sidebar with three separate APPS Compra(active), Recetas, Calorias. Only Compra subsections visible: Buscar, Listas, Favoritos, Analisis. Warm paper #F4F0E8, surface #FBF9F4, forest #183A32, ink #202724, secondary #536158, terracotta #A94D36 accent, fine rules #D8D2C7. Fraunces short headings32px; IBM Plex Sans body16px, tables14px, metadata13px, tabular numerals. Flat purposeful tables, no gradients, glass or rounded-card dashboard. Main header Comparar este producto. Product identity generic sample marca/variante/1L/1unidad. Tabs Mismo producto and Alternativas; selected Mismo producto. Comparison rows for 4 supermarkets: price, unit-price, date, club conditions; one row Sin precio actual. Explicit exact-product badge, alternative never shown as exact. Right narrow panel Mi lista with actionable quantities. Header small but visible Datos de demostracion; every number fictional demo. Footer Ajustes and Aprender. No medical widgets, recipe cards or calorie diary on this screen. Minimum44px buttons. Clean confident restrained distinctive visual design, strong hierarchy, original layout. Produce one screen only.
